decisions.reason: As a recently launched door lever handle family in a core product category, it is likely to stay unless early sales were clearly weak.
The mitred door lever handle family is somewhat more design-specific, but it still fits the firm's core architectural hardware portfolio and is too new to remove quickly.
A multifunctional door lever handle is more specialized and could face narrower demand, yet a German metal products firm would usually give such a new innovation more time in the market.
This door lever handle sits in the firm's main business area, so despite possible overlap with other models it is more likely to be retained than withdrawn after only about a year.
The collection had its own page and won a 2023 German Design Award, which strongly suggests the firm will continue backing it.
A new finish can be more vulnerable to changing taste or low uptake, but as an option across hardware lines it is still more likely to be kept than dropped.
